summary: Shell plc filed a Form 6-K reporting routine monthly share repurchases under a buy-back programme announced on 7 May 2026. The company purchased shares on 1 and 2 June 2026, with volumes and prices varying by venue (LSE, Chi-X, BATS). Goldman Sachs International is executing the programme independently within pre-set parameters. These transaction disclosures are standard periodic updates for an ongoing buy-back, not a new special situation. No terms such as a fixed price, premium, or closing date are provided. The filing is a routine notification of issuer share repurchases.
